transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Well, what brings me in is... I keep hearing these voices. They're very clear. It mostly happens in my apartment, but I've also heard them when I'm in empty museum rooms. It sounds like women whispering right from behind the walls, and they keep telling me which photographs belong in the archive.
Do the voices sound like they are coming from outside of your head, or like your own thoughts?

They definitely sound like they're coming from outside my head. Like I said, it sounds like they're right behind the walls... just these women whispering to me about the photographs. It's not my own thoughts, it's very clear.
How long have you been hearing these voices?
It's been... well, about eight months now. Yes, around eight months since the voices started. And that's also how long I've been absolutely certain that people are watching my archive.
During those eight months, have you also had a major period of depression or mania?

Yes. There were periods where I was sleeping for only a few hours a night, just racing from one archive task to another to get things organized. And during those times... even when I was rushing around like that, I was also hearing the women's voices. I was still feeling absolutely certain that the museum board was tracking my work.
Have there been times when the voices or the belief that people were watching your archive continued even when you were not depressed or manic?

Yes, actually. There was... well, a period of several weeks where I felt pretty normal. I wasn't rushing around or feeling overly energized, and I wasn't feeling down either. But even then, I still heard the women whispering in my apartment. And I was still absolutely convinced that the arts people were monitoring my phone and watching what I was doing with the archive. So, yes, it didn't just happen when I was racing around.
Have there been times during these eight months when you had a full episode of depression or mania that lasted for most of the time you were also having the voices or feeling watched?

Yes, I would say so. Honestly, most of these months since my retirement have been dominated by... well, long stretches of feeling incredibly driven. Like I was chosen for this work, and I just couldn't slow down. I was very irritable most of that time, too. So, yes, that feeling of racing and being unable to stop took up the vast majority of the time, even though I did have a few quieter, more withdrawn days mixed in.
